title: Guides bundle manifest
description: guides.json at the bundle root, contract version 0.3. See section 3 of guides-contract.md. Rules this schema does not express: the accepted contractVersion (unsupported-contract-version), the 1 MB limit on the file (size-limit), group nesting depth (nav-depth), which is checked while parsing, and each page appearing exactly once (missing-page, unlisted-page, duplicate-page).

contractVersion.description: major.minor. A portal implementing contract 0.3 accepts exactly "0.3".

sha256.description: SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the bytes of the published spec the guides were generated from: the root OpenAPI document with the accepted spec-doctor fixes applied, exactly as the portal published it, with no normalization. When no fix was applied these are the bytes of the original document. See sections 1.2 and 3 of guides-contract.md.

generatedAt.description: Optional. May be left out for byte-identical output.

slug.description: The page's file path under pages/ without the .md extension.

label.description: Plain text shown in the sidebar instead of the page title.

hidden.description: Keeps the page out of the sidebar. It is still published and linkable.
